component.name: ASGARDEX
component.summary: Cross-chain DeFi wallet for THORChain, MAYAChain, and more

description.p: ASGARDEX is a non-custodial desktop wallet and exchange client for THORChain, MAYAChain, Chainflip, and other supported networks. Swap assets across chains, manage liquidity, and hold funds with keystore, Ledger, or Vultisig vaults.
Ledger hardware wallets: on Linux, install the Ledger udev rules on the host once so the device is visible to the app (including Flatpak). See the project README for the rule package and setup steps.

screenshot.caption: Pools overview with swap and add-liquidity actions

description.p: Market and limit trading on the pool chart, RUNEBond listing tools, pinned favourites, and the MayaChain Radix delist.

ul.li: Pools: market and limit trading on the pool chart for L1 and trade-asset pairs, with a swap ticket beside the chart, limit-price lines drawn on the candles, and a list of this wallet's recent swaps for the pair with the swap receipt at the top.

Pools: limit orders fetch a fresh quote when triggered and open the wallet confirmation (never auto-signed); a quote worse than the limit fails the order, identical duplicate orders are blocked, and failed or filled orders can be removed.
Pools: the limit trigger price comes from THORNode every 6 seconds and is shown in the panel with its last check time and update interval.
Pools: pin favourite assets in the trading asset dropdown, sharing the swap menu favourites; trade-asset swaps are noted as affiliate free.
Pools: picking the chart asset in the ticket opens that pool and keeps the other side of the pair.
Bond provider refactor, block II: bonds section.
Bond provider refactor, block III: RUNEBond integration (list, update and delist a node, finder-fee vault top-up, approve whitelist requests).
UI: pin favourite assets at the top of the asset menu, saved per network.
OneClick lists Base, Tron, and Zcash in the swap picker, using the wallet's native gas asset (ETH on Base, TRX, ZEC).
A THOR or MAYA inbound check names the vault or the router that does not match the published address.
EVM: ERC-20 wallet sends drop the memo, which xchain-evm 2.1.3 rejects; THOR and MAYA swaps pay the quote inbound address and confirm that vault is still the published one.
Quiet production main-process logs, send Ledger ETH through ethereum.publicnode.com, and add the missing Ledger deposit error text.
Bonds: the bond and RUNEBond tx windows cannot be closed while a send is pending; a RUNEBond target bond must be greater than the minimum.
MayaChain delisted Radix. Swaps and liquidity for XRD are unavailable. Send on the Radix network still works, and the Radix client loads only when XRD is enabled or a Radix screen is opened.
Keep BTC Taproot swaps on the Taproot wallet; MAYAChain is left out of Taproot quotes.
UI: label Ledger mode and badge Vultisig in the header.
Floor the UTXO inbound fee at the destination protocol's gas_rate.
Tron: pass the swap into the inbound fee quote, so a native TRX swap is no longer priced as a TRC20 transfer.
Performance: keep swap and pool screens stable while data reloads; block a stale trade quote and drop held data on network change.
Performance: keep heavy chain clients and the swap aggregator off startup.

description.p: Fixes max ADA swaps, BSC sends with a zero base fee, fee-estimate swap memos, and max native RUNE deposits.

ul.li: Swap: a max ADA swap no longer spends the entire wallet balance.
EVM: set maxFeePerGas explicitly so BSC transactions build when the base fee is zero.
Swap: fee-estimate placeholder memos no longer write the slippage tolerance into the THORChain limit field.
Swap: a max native RUNE swap leaves the flat 0.02 RUNE ante on the account instead of subtracting a quoted inbound fee that can still be zero.

description.p: Added Near Client, added Zcash Thorchain support, UI improvements. New Bond Page / Bond provider tools.

ul.li: NEAR wallet client and Near Intents (OneClick) trading.
Enable THORChain routing for Zcash.
Swap: static decentralization score on quotes (THORChain 90, MAYAChain 73, Chainflip 58, NEAR Intents 25).
OneClick: request 60 bps so the partner share stays 30, and collect every OneClick affiliate fee in one ANY_INPUT pot instead of the per-chain address map.
Swap: allow ETH to NEAR via Near Intents.
UI: unlock error on the password field, stored-address confirmation, language names, logo gleam, single search border.
EVM: EIP-1559 tip and base-fee headroom for plain transfers.
Swap: stop synth sunset copy on an empty asset picker.
Bond provider refactor, block I.

description.p: OneClick fee accuracy, Midgard-resilient quotes, and safer Chainflip/THOR deposit flows.

ul.li: Swap: show the OneClick affiliate from the aggregator's echoed appFees (no more false "free"); swap details tuned per protocol for Chainflip and OneClick; outbound fee uses the quote's destination asset and USD value; swap routes no longer all freeze when THOR Midgard is down.
Swap: stop lastblock polls from re-firing quotes every 60 seconds.
Chainflip submit UX (channel-open in the transaction modal), asset search ranks native ETH first, smarter halt banners, and quotes pause while you confirm.
THORChain/MAYAChain: never auto-retry keystore MsgDeposit broadcasts.
Swap: restore the ERC20 Approve button when a quote is blocked by approval.
EVM: EIP-1559 tip and base-fee headroom for THOR/MAYA pool deposit transactions.
Swap: skip quote requests for trading-halted THOR/MAYA routes.

description.p: Fixes Solana broadcast fees, reduces THORChain API load, and advances Flatpak packaging toward Flathub.

ul.li: Solana: floor the priority fee so OneClick token swaps can broadcast.
THORChain: cut load from swap tx/stages polling (block-time floor, no pending double-fire, incomplete max-age).
Flatpak: rename the app id to com.asgardex.Asgardex, harden host keystore/Vultisig migration, and pin the Windows NSIS guid.

description.p: The Kujira client is no longer supported. New feature: keystore HD recovery with Find my funds (EVM, THOR/MAYA, UTXO), using a simple scan or custom paths.

ul.li: Keystore: HD "Find my funds" for EVM, THOR/MAYA, and UTXO chains.
EVM: re-clamp a native Max send at broadcast so fee re-quotes cannot overshoot the balance (Max no longer fails with dust insufficient-funds).
Security: update keyv to 5.6.0 (supply-chain mitigation).
Source UTXO inbound fee rates from the node gas_rate.
Swap: show the routing protocol in the chart panel and track OneClick (NEAR Intents) swaps.
Remove the native Kujira (KUJI) chain client, which is no longer listed on THOR/MAYA pools.
